risks.statement: Revenue concentration risk: Top 3 customers represent approximately 45% of total revenue based on industry benchmarks for NAICS 332710.

Machine shop industry (NAICS 332710) is cyclical and sensitive to manufacturing capital expenditure cycles. Current economic indicators suggest potential slowdown in industrial capex over next 12-18 months.
Key person dependency: Owner/CEO with 25+ years experience is central to customer relationships and technical operations. No formal succession plan documented.
